28/G.goal: Explain how human visual and spatial perception constrain the optics and display requirements of three-dimensional XR systems.
28/G.achieves: Gives the learner the human-factors foundation for evaluating and optimizing the visual hardware and user experience of an XR system.

28/O1.goal: Describe how an XR headset produces the perception of a three-dimensional virtual environment.
28/O1.achieves: Lets the learner connect human vision and motion perception to the hardware and interaction features required for immersive XR experiences.

28/O2.goal: Explain how human visual-perception constraints determine XR display requirements for spatial resolution, intensity, and temporal resolution.
28/O2.achieves: Lets the learner evaluate XR display performance against the perceptual limits that affect immersion.
